context.description: The generator refuses a machine it cannot fold safely

evidence.trustReason: Fresh-context review of packages/opencode/test/task/verify-spec-RM2.spec.ts (4 tests, my own run: 4 pass, 0 fail, 520 expect calls, 31 s). Given (two equal explicit state ids): test 1 adds a task T1_1 beside T1.1 of the loaded example-cascade plan and asserts TaskMachine.stateId gives T1_1/<state> for both ids; test 2 adds a task T1.1.c1 whose work-state ids repeat obligation T1.1.c1's ids and asserts the config holds exactly the repeated ids T1_1_c1/failed and T1_1_c1/trusted. When (the engine generates the machine): both tests call TaskMachine.machine and TaskEngineXState.initial on the clash plan. Then (dies naming the id): defectOf asserts a die, not a typed failure, with messages 'duplicate unit T1_1: T1.1, T1_1' and 'duplicate state id <first repeated id>'; test 1 also shows the plain config silently keeps one T1_1 region and the bare port accepts it, so the refusal is the generator's own check, and the unclashed plan still starts active. And (cap 1000): for every loadable task-formats/blend plan, whole-spec and per-task subtree (external regions included), config and built machine options.maxIterations equal 1000; a copy with an unguarded eventless loop gives an error snapshot naming more than 1000 microsteps, and a 50 control proves the number is the option in force. And (no delay, invoke, spawn, custom action): for every plan, recursive config scan finds no after/invoke/spawn/delay/actors/src key; the built machine has no after or invoke on any node, no xstate.after event, implementations only actions and guards; every entry, exit, eventless and event action resolves to an assign or undelayed raise; no child actor in the first snapshot or along real folds; positive controls show the scanner flags a custom function, a spawnChild and a delayed raise. Real loader, generator and engine; nothing under test is mocked.
